bio.text: Veronica Fernandez is a candidate for U.S. Senate from New Jersey in the November 3, 2026 general election, running under the "End the Corruption!" party designation against Sen. Cory Booker.
WHYY reports that she was born and raised in Franklin, New Jersey, lives in Long Valley, and worked for years as a property casualty insurance underwriter.
She previously ran for U.S. Senate in 2020, U.S. House in 2022 and the New Jersey General Assembly in 2023.

sources.title: NJ election 2026: Senate voter guide for Cory Booker's seat
